title: CO2 Transport and Storage Cost Review Webinar
summary: Free hybrid IEAGHG webinar on 1 December 2026 (09:00–10:00). Colin Laing and Phoebe Johnston of Xodus Group present findings from a review of CO2 transport and storage costs and later work, covering key cost drivers, the limits of historical cost estimates, and the need for more standardisation and better industry data.
why_it_matters: Directly relevant to cost parameters for transport and storage in network-optimisation models; discusses reliability of the cost data such models depend on.
approved_by: Published automatically (before the review step existed)
